verdict.rationale: Evidence shows Gemini CLI only supports choosing among Google's own Gemini models (gh-14, gh-24), not switching between different AI providers (e.g., OpenAI, Anthropic); community complaints (comm-2, comm-3, comm-19) reinforce that it's locked to Google's ecosystem/billing. There is no evidence of multi-provider model selection, so the story as written (choosing from multiple providers) is not delivered.
